CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFTREE

CFTREE shows a tree of folders and documents inside a CFFORM, built from CFTREEITEM tags or from a query. The user selects an item by clicking it, and the selection is submitted with the form; items can also be links. KoldFusion renders the 1999 tree applet as an HTML outline with clickable [+] and [-] markers.

Category

Forms

Syntax

<CFTREE NAME="name"
    REQUIRED="Yes/No"
    MESSAGE="text"
    FONT="font_name"
    WIDTH="pixels"
    DELIMITER="delimiter"
    COMPLETEPATH="Yes/No"
    APPENDKEY="Yes/No"
    HIGHLIGHTHREF="Yes/No"
    ONVALIDATE="javascript_function"
    ONERROR="javascript_function"
    FONTSIZE="integer"
    ITALIC="Yes/No"
    BOLD="Yes/No"
    HEIGHT="pixels"
    BORDER="Yes/No"
    HSCROLL="Yes/No"
    VSCROLL="Yes/No"
    NOTSUPPORTED="text">
  CFTREEITEM tags
</CFTREE>

Attributes

NAME
Required. Name of the tree. The selection is submitted as the form field name.node.
REQUIRED
Optional, default "No". Yes: the user must select an item before the form is submitted.
MESSAGE
Optional. Alert text when REQUIRED fails. Default "Please select an item in the tree."
FONT
Optional, default "Arial". Font face of the items.
WIDTH
Optional, default "250". Width of the tree box.
DELIMITER
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it (query-built paths use "/").
COMPLETEPATH
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
APPENDKEY
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion always appends CFTREEITEMKEY to item links.
HIGHLIGHTHREF
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
ONVALIDATE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
ONERROR
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
FONTSIZE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
ITALIC
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
BOLD
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
HEIGHT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it (the box grows to fit).
BORDER
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
HSCROLL
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
VSCROLL
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
NOTSUPPORTED
Optional. Text for browsers without Java. No longer needed; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

Clicking an item that has no HREF selects it: its VALUE goes into a hidden field named name.node, and the browser's status bar shows it. Because the field name contains a dot, read it in the action page with StructFind(Form, "name.node") and test for it with StructKeyExists.

Items with an HREF are ordinary links; the target page receives the item's VALUE as URL.CFTREEITEMKEY.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetStaff" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT Department, Emp_ID, LastName, FirstName
FROM Employees ORDER BY Department, LastName
</CFQUERY>

<CFIF StructKeyExists(Form, "StaffTree.node")>
  <CFSET Picked = StructFind(Form, "StaffTree.node")>
  <CFOUTPUT><P>You selected the item <B>#Picked#</B>
  <CFLOOP QUERY="GetStaff">
    <CFIF Emp_ID EQ ListLast(Picked, "/")>: #FirstName# #LastName#, #Department#</CFIF>
  </CFLOOP>
  </CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>

<CFFORM NAME="Directory" ACTION="cftree.cfm">
<P>Open a department, click a name, then press Show.
<CFTREE NAME="StaffTree" WIDTH="300" REQUIRED="Yes"
    MESSAGE="Click a name in the tree first.">
  <CFTREEITEM VALUE="Department,Emp_ID" DISPLAY="Department,LastName"
      QUERY="GetStaff">
</CFTREE>
<INPUT TYPE="Submit" VALUE="Show">
</CFFORM>
